query.description: Free-text search string. Required unless flagged_only is true or tag, files, symbols or error_text is provided.

tag.description: Filter to entries whose tags array contains this value (exact match, ANDed alongside other filters -- not an FTS term). May be used alone (no query) to list all entries carrying the tag.

limit.description: Max L1 results. Default 20; a MEMBER session that omits it gets 6 slim rows (id, title, summary, confidence, source_files) with expanded content for the top 3. An explicit limit always wins and keeps the full row shape.

include_stale.description: Include stale and superseded entries (default false)

flagged_only.description: Return all contradiction-flagged entries. When true, query is optional and full content is returned.

expand_related.description: Append entries connected to the top hits by a refines or contradiction_of edge, as related_claims. These are the KB's own judgements about its contents -- "there is a newer framing of this" and "something disputes this" -- which a text match cannot surface. shares_file/shares_symbol edges are NOT traversed: FTS over the same fields already finds those. Default false, in which case related_claims is absent.

confidence.description: Only return entries whose confidence tier is in this list (e.g. ["CONFIRMED"]). Applies to l1_results, l2_expanded and related_claims alike. Default when omitted: ["CONFIRMED"] -- INFERRED and UNVERIFIED entries are returned only when listed explicitly. Ignored when flagged_only is true.

exclude_disputed.description: Drop entries on either side of an unresolved contradiction (flagged_for_review, or contradiction_of set). Applies to l1_results, l2_expanded and related_claims alike. Default true when confidence is omitted (CONFIRMED-undisputed default); default false when confidence is given explicitly. Ignored when flagged_only is true.

files.description: Optional file paths you are working on. Entries whose source_files (or code-index links) touch these files rank higher. Additive: omit it and the result is unchanged.

symbols.description: Optional symbol names you are working on. Entries naming these symbols, or linked one code-graph hop from them, rank higher.

error_text.description: Optional error message you hit. Matched against the error_signatures of entries and added to the semantic search text, so an entry that explains this error is returned.

relevant_only.description: Optional. Return only rows with strong keyword evidence for this query: a row is kept when its keyword match is strong both for the size of the KB and against the best keyword match of the query, or when its error_signatures match error_text. Semantic and file/symbol matches still order the kept rows but never admit a row on their own. Fewer rows, possibly none. Meant for context pushed without being asked for. Default false: results unchanged. Local SQLite KB only; an HTTP KB backend ignores it.

repo_path.description: REMOVED -- do not pass. A call carrying it fails with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED; the KB is always the calling session's own.

repo.description: REMOVED -- do not pass. A call carrying it fails with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED; the KB is always the calling session's own.

repo_remote_url.description: REMOVED -- do not pass. A call carrying it fails with E-SCOPE-KEY-REMOVED; the KB is always the calling session's own.
